notes.title: Ver1.02
notes.content:
・The function to place a marker light by right-clicking has been added. This function allows you to place markers on the road.
・A crash when exiting the game by pressing Space at the ending has been resolved. The game exiting itself is a correct operation.
・The time that footprints remain in the footprint function has been increased from 30 to 60 seconds.

notes.title: Tips for escaping from the upper level to "Gate of the Outer World"
notes.content:
*This article contains spoilers.

Thank you for playing “Ghost Infinite Labyrinth”.
We created this work as a high difficulty labyrinth, but we had the impression that some of you were having a hard time on the way from warping to the upper level 1 using the help function to the "Gate of the Outer World", so we have included the route from the upper level 1 to the "Gate of the Outer World" here.
(We created this article because we thought that many of those who were using the help function to warp to listing 1 were either on the verge of losing their minds or did not have enough time.)


Route of the * strategy
Warp to the upper level 1 using the help function.
→Open the sliding door nearby and climb the stairs ahead.
→Open the sliding door on the right and go straight ahead.
→Go straight ahead and climb the stairs.
→Cross the bridge at the end of the side path.
→Go down the stairs at the end of the bridge.
→Open the sliding door at the end of the stairs.
→Open the sliding door to the left of the sliding door.
→Arrive at the "Gate of the Outer World".

notes.title: Ver1.01
notes.content: Fixed a phenomenon in which some soul fragments remained on the map without being reset when soul fragments were repositioned at game over (causing multiple identical soul fragments to exist on the map).
